complaints.theme: Food served cold or lukewarm on arrival
quotes: Four beef orders were luke-warm to cold. My walleye seemed overcooked.
I had the risotto and duck it came out ice cold... I couldn't eat the risotto as it was cold and gummy.
Went for dinner with friends, their scallops were delivered cold, and they didn't dare eat.
Our food when it finally came was cold and 2 people did not get their food.
"Caramelized bananas" on the dessert were cold bananas with raw sugar sprinkled on them.
The service was great but the food is Always cold!

complaints.theme: Signature steak cuts and specialty dishes unavailable
quotes: Place had no ribeye or tbone or top sirloin on menu... Will never go back
Out of the lobster pasta special on Valentine's Day. Gotta get someone back there who knows how to order.
No walleye on a Friday night and overcooked food.
Came for Bison burger but they do not have it any more.
Excellent place... Need to add ribeye to the menu though.
Steak selection is very limited and over priced for choice cuts. We got drinks and headed elsewhere.
We waited over an hour for our bills... my sister in laws bachlorette was ruined
Days later, we find they charged us for some of the girls meals who already paid via cash or card.
We booked a Christmas party 2 weeks in advance. Ordered apps that never came. Our food when it finally came was cold and 2 people did not get their food.
Pathetic service... we had to wait like 2 hours for the bills???????
Nice place, forgot half our groups orders, messed up the drinks, forgot drinks, forgot our appetizers

complaints.theme: Reservation system unreliable / walk-ins seated ahead of reservations
quotes: First, they lost our reservation... The hostess commented on how their system 'loses' reservations.
I show up 7 minutes early for my reservation for 2 and then other people show up about 12 minutes after that and get seated immediately
We tried to book a group for 7 and said they would call us back. They never did, so we booked elsewhere.
I had a reservation, which I was sat in the middle of two very loud parties... I left. Didn't even eat.

complaints.theme: Discontinued or missing menu items customers ask for
quotes: First time there. We will be back next time in Fargo. I did not see duck on the menu.
Came for Bison burger but they do not have it any more.
the only recommendation is to add more vegetarian dishes with gluten free appetizers!

gifts.title: Tonight's Board — steak & specialty availability sign
gifts.for_complaint: Signature steak cuts and specialty dishes unavailable
gifts.deliverable: A print-ready host-stand sign listing Porter Creek's actual cuts and recurring-request dishes (Ribeye, T-Bone, Top Sirloin, Hanger Steak, NY Strip, Tenderloin, Buffalo Walleye, Bison Burger, Rotisserie Chicken, weekend specials) with a wipe-clean checkbox column, sized to print as an 8.5x11 host-stand card or laminated table-side card. Delivered as an HTML file/URL.
gifts.inputs_needed: Porter Creek's own current menu/steak list, pulled from portercreek.com (site returns 200 — publicly reachable) to get exact dish names and pricing right.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It uses their own dish names off their own menu and directly answers the January 2026 review ('no ribeye or tbone or top sirloin... will never go back') — a host can hold it up and start using it at tonight's shift, no software, no login, no cost.

gifts.title: Big Table — pre-split-check playbook for parties of 8+
gifts.deliverable: One-page laminated protocol card for host/server/kitchen: collect each guest's payment method at seating for parties of 8+, assign one lead server plus a designated food-runner, course-fire timer prompts, and a scripted recovery line for a missed course. Delivered as a printable HTML page.
gifts.inputs_needed: None — built entirely from the repeated failure pattern already documented in five 1-star reviews (June-July 2024) and three more (December 2025) describing the identical breakdown.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It names the exact failure from their own reviews (2-hour bill waits, double charges, no manager in sight) and hands tonight's host a floor procedure, not a marketing idea.

gifts.title: Reservation backup log for a system that 'loses' bookings
gifts.for_complaint: Reservation system unreliable / walk-ins seated ahead of reservations
gifts.deliverable: A printable paper backup reservation log (time, party name, size, phone) plus an arrival-order card for the host stand, so a software glitch doesn't cost a table. Delivered as a fill-in PDF/HTML sheet.
gifts.inputs_needed: None beyond what the reviews already reveal (a Porter Creek hostess is quoted admitting the system 'loses' reservations).
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It quotes their own staff about their own known software bug and gives a $0 paper fallback usable this weekend, with no vendor call required.
